evidence_boundary: W1 pilot is configuration evidence only; no pilot measurements set these thresholds

approval.rule: Explicit maintainer approval of policy and workload, then separate paid-run authorization, must be recorded before an instance starts.

policy_source: Proposed policy choice; issues 118 and 221 provide no numeric acceptance limits.

repetitions.order: seeded shuffle, then rotated and reversed counterbalance
repetitions.bootstrap: 10,000 paired resamples with replacement using seed 118; one-sided 95th percentile upper bound; never resample incomplete pairs
repetitions.failed_or_partial: retain; never silently replace; any new run gets a new immutable ID

memory_reduction.metric: added combined target plus helper peak RSS and median measured-window RSS, computed separately
memory_reduction.baseline: matched profiler-off; comparison mode is public PyTorch or vLLM public-engine
memory_reduction.denominator: positive public mode added RSS in each paired repetition
memory_reduction.aggregation: paired median over five complete repetitions; 95% bootstrap upper bound of direct_cupti_added/public_added using all paired repetitions, fixed seed 118
memory_reduction.pass: both peak and sustained median reduction >= 0.25 and both upper ratio bounds <= 0.75
memory_reduction.unknown_rule: nonpositive or missing denominator, missing target or helper process, or incomplete resource sampling is inconclusive
memory_reduction.additional_domains: report GPU, pinned host, and collector buffer memory separately; do not claim total-memory reduction while any material domain is unknown
memory_reduction.rationale: Require a material saving that persists across paired runs and includes helper memory.

latency_perturbation.metric: successful-request p95 end-to-end latency per measured repetition
latency_perturbation.baseline: matched profiler-off repetition on the same workload
latency_perturbation.aggregation: paired median and 95% bootstrap upper bound with fixed seed 118
latency_perturbation.pass: median and upper bound <= 0.05 for each routine capture mode, with sample sufficiency and no unexplained successful-throughput regression
latency_perturbation.unknown_rule: missing successful-request population or baseline is inconclusive
latency_perturbation.rationale: Bound routine collection overhead while keeping intrusive correctness references separate.

correlation_coverage.metric: eligible timed device-kernel records with unique valid host-launch correlation and device timestamp
correlation_coverage.baseline: native trace plus deterministic W1-W3 expected operations and separate trusted Nsight timeline
correlation_coverage.denominator: all eligible timed device-kernel records in the declared measurement window, including unmatched records
correlation_coverage.pass: fraction >= 0.99 in every nominal repetition and no missing kernel class against external correctness evidence
correlation_coverage.unknown_rule: missing or untrustworthy external coverage makes completeness inconclusive
correlation_coverage.rationale: An internally consistent trace may omit an entire activity class.

event_loss.metric: reported dropped / (delivered + dropped) per applicable loss domain
event_loss.baseline: raw collector counters and W4 induced-pressure ground truth
event_loss.denominator: delivered plus dropped records for each applicable domain; zero or unknown is inconclusive
event_loss.aggregation: evaluate every nominal repetition and each W4 pressure trial separately
event_loss.pass: zero drops and no silent or unknown loss in every nominal trial; W4 must explicitly surface 100% of induced drops or truncations
event_loss.unknown_rule: do not treat a nonapplicable domain as zero; retain raw counters and unsupported results
event_loss.rationale: Nominal traces must be complete and pressure failures must be visible.

sample_sufficiency.metric: offered and successful measured requests and complete matched repetitions
sample_sufficiency.baseline: fixed request schedule and profiler-off matched runs
sample_sufficiency.denominator: 2200 scheduled offered requests per repetition and five complete matched repetitions
sample_sufficiency.aggregation: per repetition and pooled by mode
sample_sufficiency.pass: five complete matched repetitions; at least 2200 offered and 2000 successful measured requests per repetition; at least 10000 successful pooled per mode before p99 claim
sample_sufficiency.unknown_rule: shortfall is inconclusive, never a pass; preserve every failed or partial run
sample_sufficiency.rationale: At least about 100 pooled observations fall in the upper 1% when the p99 population threshold is met.

vllm.status: proposed; CPU adapter exists, hardware compatibility and profiler behavior unverified

server.gpu: one NVIDIA L4, subject to compatibility preflight
server.kv_cache_dtype: auto with FP16 model configuration; record resolved dtype

request.user_message: Explain in one paragraph why a GPU kernel launch can precede its execution. Include one example.
request.request_ids: stormlog-118-{phase}-{zero-padded-index}; same ordered IDs and body in every mode

arrivals.overload_accounting: rejected, timed-out, and failed requests remain in the offered population; do not shift later arrivals

vllm.separate_correctness_mode: Nsight Systems with no concurrent CUPTI unless coexistence independently qualifies
vllm.graph_claim: none from this eager workload; use W3 and separate graph trials

implemented_cpu_tested: missing CUPTI process and incomplete stream fail-closed
requires_hardware_preflight: vLLM wheel, CUDA, CUPTI, and driver compatibility
direct CUPTI process isolation and all CUDA process coverage
requires_tooling_before_final: measured GPU, pinned host, and collector buffer memory or explicit inconclusive claims
separate per-process CUPTI output if vLLM has multiple CUDA processes

local: verify current PR head and clean tree
freeze approved thresholds and workload before final observations
hardware_qualification: W2 observed overlap and serialized control
AMD as independent qualification lane where required
comparisons: vLLM public-engine and Proton where applicable
readiness.artifacts: fresh immutable IDs, exact commands, environment, versions, exits, failures, raw hashes, loss counters, download and verify before pause
readiness.cloud: one instance at a time; on-demand L4 preferred if compatible; pause immediately after work; other cloud only where necessary and separately authorized
readiness.cost_unknown_reason: Current rate alone does not establish setup time, trial duration, storage charges, or alternate-cloud price.
